purpose: Add a current-source RLinear (RevIN plus linear mapping) reference on the core long-term forecasting coordinates.
research_question: How strong is a normalization-aware linear baseline under the current data, split, optimizer and validation contract?
evidence_boundary: Validation-only baseline extension. Every job sets skip_test=true; no test metrics, prediction arrays, or test selection are permitted.
claim_boundary: These RLinear records are a current-source baseline table. They cannot be paired statistically with historical candidate artifacts from another source snapshot and do not establish an AutoCon effect.

required_before_launch: verify all six dataset hashes and dimensions
keep test execution disabled for every job
preserve a single source snapshot and immutable output roots

selection_contract.freeze_rule: RLinear is fixed to per-window affine RevIN plus a shared linear time map; no post-hoc individual-channel switch, horizon-specific hyperparameter change, or test read is allowed.

phases.name: rlinear_core_h96_validation
phases.purpose: RLinear H96 validation references across low-, medium-, and high-dimensional core datasets.

phases.name: rlinear_ili_h24_validation
phases.purpose: RLinear H24 validation reference on the short ILI coordinate.

comparison_contract.reporting_rule: Report these values as RLinear-only current-source references. Do not calculate paired candidate deltas unless a future phase trains all compared arms from one frozen source snapshot.

prelaunch_gates: verify all six dataset hashes and dimensions
keep test execution disabled for every job
preserve a single source snapshot and immutable output roots
